facts.fact: Jordan 在嘉年华上自我怀疑：她本是从不回避冲突的人，却在父母 villa 偷听时"临阵脱逃"跑了。
facts.anchor: She couldn’t believe that she’d chickened out at her parents’ villa.

facts.fact: 几个月前队友 Vicki 散布谣言说 Jordan 服用了提升成绩的补剂——她没告诉任何人，直接去更衣室对质，Vicki 承认撒谎，名声才恢复。
facts.anchor: one of her teammates, Vicki, started a rumor about Jordan taking some type of performance-enhancing supplement

facts.fact: Jordan 的疑问清单：爸爸做了什么导致全家被"发配"温哥华？Nan 又是怎么牵连进来的？
facts.anchor: For instance: What had her dad done to get them shipped off to Vancouver? And how was Nan involved?

facts.fact: Milo 收到 Kurt 短信邀约：要去看 Thrill Harbor 一段 off-the-map 的地方，问 Lily 要不要同行；Kurt 是 Milo 的 homeschool 同伴、同属初级辅导员实习项目。
facts.anchor: “It’s a little crazy, but he’s about to check out this part of Thrill Harbor that’s off the map and he invited me to go along. What do you think? Want to come?”

facts.fact: Kurt 的"好货"：听辅导员说岛南端有几座在建骑乘，其中"Plunge"是临海巨大悬崖边的自由落体——500 英尺、全球最大，属 Phase 2 工程。
facts.anchor: I heard some counselors talking about a couple of under-construction rides on the southern tip of the island,” Kurt responded. “One of them is called the Plunge. It’s a free-fall, right off an enormous coastal cliff.

facts.fact: Jordan 同行的动机：要证明自己不是"一有压力就跑的人"；肾上腺素冲击本是她的 happy place，能麻痹这几周的挫败。
facts.anchor: Besides, Jordan had to prove she wasn’t a person who ran off when the heat was on.

facts.fact: 崖顶月光下 Jordan 深呼吸默念"I will be okay."——话音刚落风暴就到：雷声炸响、闪电划空、倾盆大雨。
森林逃回时 Milo 滑倒摔得极重、手电摔坏、痛苦呻吟没了回应；Lily 挣脱 Jordan 的手、把共同的手电掉进泥坑冲向 Milo。
facts.anchor: Then, up ahead, she saw Milo slip and fall, crashing to the ground so hard his flashlight broke.

facts.fact: Jordan 从泥坑里捞回手电拍亮——正好看见 Lily 头也不回地狂奔而去，章节在此断在悬念上。
facts.anchor: Just in time for Jordan to see Lily breaking into a run without looking back.
